Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.skin

Schnittstelle SkinService

public interface SkinService
Resolves SkinSources into NpcSkins, with caching.

Every method that may need a network call returns a CompletableFuture and does its work off the main thread. That is not a style preference: a Mojang lookup takes tens to hundreds of milliseconds, and a server tick is fifty, so a synchronous lookup during a chunk load would stall the whole server. The only synchronous method here, cached(SkinSource), is explicitly the one that never talks to the network.

Returned futures complete on a background thread. Bukkit API calls in a continuation must be scheduled back onto the main thread.

1.0.0

  • Methodendetails

    • resolve

      CompletableFuture<Optional<NpcSkin>> resolve(SkinSource source)
      Resolves a skin, consulting the cache first and the registered providers second.
      Parameter:
      source - the source to resolve
      Gibt zurück:
      a future completing with the skin, or with an empty value if no provider knows it; the future completes exceptionally only if every provider failed
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if source is null

    • cached

      Optional<NpcSkin> cached(SkinSource source)
      Returns a skin from the cache without any lookup.

      Safe to call on the main thread. Use it to render immediately when the skin happens to be known and fall back to resolve(SkinSource) otherwise.

      Parameter:
      source - the source to look up
      Gibt zurück:
      the cached skin, or empty if it has not been resolved yet or the entry has expired
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if source is null

    • invalidate

      void invalidate(SkinSource source)
      Drops the cached skin for a source, so that the next resolution fetches it again.
      Parameter:
      source - the source to forget
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if source is null

    • invalidateAll

      void invalidateAll()
      Drops every cached skin.

      Called by /npc reload. Cheap — the next render of each NPC re-resolves what it needs — but it does mean a burst of lookups on a busy server, so it is not something to do on a timer.

    • registerProvider

      void registerProvider(SkinProvider provider)
      Registers a provider.
      Parameter:
      provider - the provider to add
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if provider is null
      IllegalStateException - if a provider with the same SkinProvider.id() is already registered
